title: Rikit sitao: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: Rikit sitao: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: Rikit sitao is a pole sitao variety from BPI NCRDC Los Baños, Laguna. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Rikit sitao is a pole sitao variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council (NSIC) in 2008 as NSIC 2008 PS 05. BPI NCRDC Los Baños, Laguna bred it. It takes about 46 days from sowing to the first harvest, with 8.51 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Rikit sitao takes about 46 days from sowing to the first harvest. That is about the average of the 7 pole sitao varieties with a day count, 45.4 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 8.51 t/ha trails the average of its group, 11.33. It sits in the lower quarter of its group. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in the registry trials, rated under natural field conditions
rows: Took a middling share of damage

blocks.text: The pests and diseases that hit sitao fields most often: [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [bean fly](/pests/bean-fly), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [legume pod borer](/pests/legume-pod-borer). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its pods grew about 62.5 cm long. The seed coat is brown.
Where and when to plant Rikit sitao

It is recommended for both the wet and the dry season. Pole sitao climbs a trellis and bears for weeks, while bush sitao needs no trellis and comes in at once. Pick long, dark green pods that snap cleanly, and a variety rated against the bean fly and rust if you can. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 46 days from sowing to the first harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 8.51 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Rikit?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
